uptime.math: One Pro subscription covers 5 sites. The listed price is $30 or ₹2,853 a month. Whether paid 60-second checks and an own-domain page are included isn't confirmed.
25 sites fit the Pro plan's 50-site cap, at $30 or ₹2,853 a month. Whether a 60-second minimum and an own-domain page are included isn't confirmed.
100 sites fit the Agency plan's 100-site cap, at $50 or ₹4,755 a month. Whether one-minute checks and an own-domain page are included isn't confirmed.
